name: Moses Brown Performing and Visual Arts Camps
operator_name: Moses Brown School (Moses Brown Auxiliary Services)
description_short: A set of week-long arts day programs at Moses Brown School in Providence: fashion design, art portfolio prep, art exploration, theatre, and string orchestra/strings camp. Most run 8:30am-3:00pm. Ages and grades vary by program and together cover about ages 8-18.
